description: Navigation between settings areas, with groups and the current section marked.

howToUse: Use it on the left of a settings screen, to move between its areas: Profile, Team, Billing, Security.
Split long lists with `groups`, and mark the area open with `activeHref`.
Pass your router's link in `renderLink`, so the navigation does not reload the page.
alternatives: Steps that must be followed in order: WizardStepper.
Sections of the same long page: TableOfContents.

keyboard.action: Moves from one area to the next.

props.name: items
props.description: Ungrouped items. Ignored if `groups` is passed.

props.name: groups
props.description: Items grouped with a section title.

props.name: renderLink
props.type: ((item: SettingsSubnavItem, linkProps: SettingsSubnavLinkProps) => ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>) | undefined
props.description:
Injectable link rendering, matches the router Link without coupling:
`renderLink={(item, p) => <Link {...p} href={item.href} />}`.
Default: `<a {...p} />`.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Fired on any item click (besides navigation).
